appSubtitle: Translate your subtitles hassle-free, with precision.
promptPlaceholder: Or paste subtitle text here (SRT, VTT, or ASS format is auto-detected)
fileValidationSRTError: Invalid SRT file. Please check the format.
fileValidationVTTError: Invalid VTT file. Missing WEBVTT header or malformed.
fileValidationASSError: Invalid ASS/SSA file. Could not find [Script Info], [Events], or Dialogue lines.
unsupportedFileType: Unsupported file type. Please upload a .srt, .vtt, .ass, or .ssa file.
fileReadError: Error reading the file. It may be corrupted or too large.
charCountWarning: Warning: Very long text may take longer or hit API limits.
errorMissing: API key and subtitle text are required.
errorNetwork: Network error. Please check your internet connection.
errorUnknown: An unknown error occurred. Please try again.
errorNoDownloadText: No translated text available to download.
apiKeyTooltip: Enter the API key for your selected provider: from Google AI Studio for Gemini models, from the DeepSeek platform for DeepSeek models, or from the Anthropic console for Claude models. The key is only used for, and stored under, that provider.
saveApiKeyTooltip: If checked, your API key is stored locally in your browser. Uncheck to remove it.
modelTooltip: AI models are updated and retired frequently. Models marked with * are usually faster/cheaper but have tighter usage limits. Always check exact model IDs and current pricing on the official docs: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models for Gemini, api-docs.deepseek.com for DeepSeek, docs.claude.com for Claude.
temperatureTooltip: Lower values (e.g. 0.2) give more predictable, literal translations. Higher values (e.g. 0.9) encourage more creativity and word variety. Default: 0.7
toneTooltip: Choose the style and tone for the translated dialogue to match your content's context.
targetLangTooltip: Choose the language you want the subtitles translated into.
uploadFileTooltip: Click to upload a subtitle file (.srt, .vtt, .ass, or .ssa) from your device.
outputFileNameTooltip: Enter a custom name for the translated file. If left empty, a name will be generated automatically.
customPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Don't translate character names / use a humorous tone / use casual, everyday wording...
customPromptTooltip: Add any extra instructions you want the model to follow while translating. This is applied as extra style/context guidance and can't override the SRT/VTT formatting rules.
translationCancelled: Translation was cancelled by the user.
manualModeTooltip: Turn this on to translate line-by-line yourself instead of using AI. The original text appears on the left; type your translation on the right. Everything is saved automatically.
manualEditorEmptyHint: Upload a subtitle file or paste its text above to get started.
manualAutoSaveHint: Everything is saved automatically in this browser.
chunkSizeTooltip: How many subtitle lines are sent to the model per request. A smaller size is more stable but needs more requests; a larger size is faster and cheaper but slightly raises the risk of lines getting out of sync.
partialTranslationSaved: {current} of {total} parts translated. Click "Resume Translation" to continue from here.
rateLimitTooltip: Adds a pause between consecutive requests to the model, lowering the chance of hitting the provider's rate limit. Useful for large files or free-tier accounts.
postProcessTooltip: After translating, automatically splits lines that got too long into two, for better subtitle readability. Only applies to SRT/VTT.
assFormatNote: For ASS/SSA files, only the dialogue text is translated - styling, timing, and effects are left untouched.
